notes: Summary: Locus is evaluating Redwood Private VPC for customer-facing fraud analysis and KYC pipelines. High security bar — must satisfy encryption posture and audit requirements.
Encryption posture specifics captured on call 2026-02-18:
- In-transit: mandatory mTLS for all data plane connections; expect mutual client certs + rotation policy every 90 days.
- Control plane: admin API access via SSO + IP allowlist to management subnets; prefer private control plane option (no public endpoint).
- At-rest: all model inputs, outputs and KV cache must be encrypted with CMKs (customer-managed keys). BYOK required; keys stored in HSM-backed KMS (customer uses KeySafe HSM provider).

- Key rotation: rotate data encryption key (DEK) quarterly; recommend envelope encryption with monthly DEK rotation and CMK rotation annually. Account security wants automated rotation hooks (Redwood API) + rotation audit trail.
- Secrets management: integrate Redwood with Vault (HashiCorp) for ephemeral secrets; must support automatic secret revocation on instance termination.
- Audit logging: 12mo immutable logs, export to their SIEM (Splunk) in near-real-time; logs must include token-level request IDs, key-id used, and KMS audit events.
- Data residency: EU-Germany primary region, no cross-border replication without explicit consent; require region tagging and policy enforcement.
